scope: Independent five-module stale-test repair audit after the frozen full baseline; offline unit evidence only.

changes.change: Pass the last recorded model receipt timestamp as now, proving it follows all supplied Results and precedes the unchanged archived deadline.

changes.cause: The old 12000-token positive expectation predates the explicit v53 code-context capacity limit.
changes.change: A fresh 12000-budget Run must fail closed with ContextLimitError; a separate fresh 64000-budget Run must fit. Every candidate retains literal writer ID and empty depends_on.
changes.retained_assertions: Native ACTION_SCHEMAS, no PROPOSAL_SCHEMA/string_steps, transitive dependency instruction on success, unchanged objects and persisted Run bytes, fixed configuration/budget, zero model records/calls. No failed Run budget is enlarged.

execution_and_integrity.legacy_scope_production_change: Applied separately by repair_diagnosis before this test group; not attributed to these test-only changes.

limitations: 135 passing unit cases establish this bounded test group, not the full repository regression or a new real-model/ORCA acceptance run.

A further full repository regression is not executed, following the user's explicit instruction. The earlier full baseline and its 23 failures remain historical evidence; these targeted repairs do not replace that baseline.
The first 132-pass/3-failure run and its original XML/log are preserved; the final result does not rewrite that failure history.
The code-authorized 12000-token case remains unsupported and is explicitly verified to fail closed; the 64000 positive control uses a distinct Run.
Current test-file hashes were collected after the targeted run; this is not a claim of an independent whole-repository freeze around that run.
